observations: Photo 0 shows a yellow industrial/diesel engine block with valve cover, fuel filter, alternator, and various hoses attached, sitting in a cluttered workshop.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the black valve cover with embossed/printed text and a metal data plate, but the lettering is small, worn, and not clearly legible.
No full view of the engine from all sides (back, bottom, oil pan, flywheel housing) is provided.
No visible serial number plate close-up that is in focus and fully readable.
Watermark 'DNL EQUIPMENT SALES AND ...' overlays both photos, seller's own branding, not proof of item identity.
No photo showing the engine running, turning over, or any compression/leak test.

identity.kind: diesel engine, sold as parts/complete unit (seller claims Caterpillar C9)

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a data plate and valve cover markings, but text is too small/worn to confirm 'C9' or 'Caterpillar' branding; no full 360-degree view to confirm completeness (no photos of rear, oil pan, flywheel, or accessory drive).

risks.risk: Model/engine family cannot be confirmed as Caterpillar C9 versus a similar CAT or other-brand industrial engine.
risks.proof: Close-up, in-focus photo of the engine serial/model data plate (usually on the block side or valve cover) showing full engine and arrangement numbers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unidentified/unbranded used diesel engine, not as a confirmed CAT C9

risks.risk: Completeness is unverified; turbo, injectors, ECU, wiring harness, or flywheel housing could be missing.
risks.proof: Photos from all four sides plus top and bottom (oil pan, flywheel housing, intake/exhaust manifolds, turbo) showing all major components attached.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete/parts engine missing major components

risks.risk: Running condition and internal mechanical health (compression, crankshaft, bearings) cannot be judged from static photos.
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking/running, or a compression test report with readings.

risks.risk: Hidden damage such as cracked block, water ingress, or corrosion under the visible grime/rust.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the block casting, cylinder bores (if accessible), and any visible cracks or corrosion spots in good lighting.

risks.risk: Unknown hours/usage history and prior rebuild status.
risks.proof: Any maintenance records, hour meter photo, or seller's documented service history.

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the engine data/serial plate showing model and arrangement numbers
Photos of all sides of the engine (rear, bottom/oil pan, flywheel housing, turbo, intake/exhaust) to confirm completeness
Video of the engine being cranked or running, if claimed functional
Any available maintenance/service history or hour meter reading
response.reason: The seller's core claim of 'Caterpillar C9' cannot be confirmed from the blurry data plate shown, and this model identification is the main driver of price for a used industrial engine; without a legible plate or more complete views, even a worst-case price cannot be reliably anchored to the right comparable.
